source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The record's source if the unioning functionality is used. Otherwise this field will be empty.

date_day.name: date_day
date_day.comment: Day the cost and usage apply to.

user_id.name: user_id
user_id.comment: Unique identifier for the OpenAI Platform user.

actor_email.name: actor_email
actor_email.comment: Email address of the person behind this activity, lowercased. Used as the durable person key across the enterprise and Codex reports, since it survives key rotations and offboarding in a way an internal ID does not. Only present when the `codex_usage` table is synced.

count_lines_of_code_added.name: count_lines_of_code_added
count_lines_of_code_added.comment: Lines of code added via Codex-attributed commits for this person on this day. Only present when the `codex_usage` table is synced.

count_lines_of_code_removed.name: count_lines_of_code_removed
count_lines_of_code_removed.comment: Lines of code removed via Codex-attributed commits for this person on this day. Only present when the `codex_usage` table is synced.

count_threads.name: count_threads
count_threads.comment: Codex conversation threads started by this person on this day. Only present when the `codex_usage` table is synced.

count_turns.name: count_turns
count_turns.comment: Codex conversation turns by this person on this day. Only present when the `codex_usage` table is synced.

count_models_used.name: count_models_used
count_models_used.comment: Distinct Codex models this person used on this day. Only present when the `codex_usage_model` table is synced.

credits.name: credits

input_tokens.name: input_tokens

metadata.name: openai__cost_usage_report
metadata.comment: Daily OpenAI Platform spend and token usage by project, model, and token_unit_type, plus an org-level `cost_type = 'other'` row for cost not tied to a project or model — kept so `sum(openai_cost)` always ties to the source `cost` table. `cost_attribution_method` marks how `openai_cost` was determined for `tokens` rows: `direct` (Costs API-reported), `allocated` (inferred via an implied per-token rate), `unallocated`, or `unmatched` (cost exists with no completion volume to allocate against, or vice versa). Still useful with only the `cost` or only the `completion` table synced — see column descriptions for what drops.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The record's source if the unioning functionality is used. Otherwise this field will be empty.

date_day.name: date_day
date_day.comment: Day the cost and usage apply to.

project_id.name: project_id
project_id.comment: Unique identifier for the OpenAI Platform project. Null on `other`-cost_type rows that couldn't be tied to a project.

project_name.name: project_name
project_name.comment: Display name of the OpenAI Platform project. Only present when the `project` table is synced. Null wherever project_id is null.

model.name: model
model.comment: Name of the OpenAI model used for this request (e.g. `gpt-4o`, `text-embedding-3-small`). Null on `other`-cost_type rows, which don't break out by model.

model_family.name: model_family
model_family.comment: Structural reporting family parsed from the model name, preserving version lines such as `gpt-4o`, `gpt-5.2`, and `o4`. Fine-tuned `ft:` names use their base model. `openai_model_family_overrides` takes precedence for exact base-model names. Unrecognized names return the original model value. Null on `other`-cost_type rows.

model_variant.name: model_variant
model_variant.comment: The model-name suffix remaining after its family and any dated snapshot suffix are removed — for example, `gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18` yields `mini`. Null when no suffix remains or the name is unrecognized. Null on `other`-cost_type rows.

token_unit_type.name: token_unit_type
token_unit_type.comment: `input`, `cache_read`, `output`, or `cache_write` — the kind of token this row's usage and/or cost belongs to. Null on `other`-cost_type rows, which don't break out by token type.

token_quantity.name: token_quantity
token_quantity.comment: Number of tokens of `token_unit_type` metered for this row. Null on `other`-cost_type rows and on `cache_write` rows, since the Completions API doesn't report cache-write token volume. Only present when the `completion` table is synced.

num_model_requests.name: num_model_requests
num_model_requests.comment: Number of API requests to the underlying model represented by this usage record. Only present when the `completion` table is synced.

cost_type.name: cost_type
cost_type.comment: `tokens` for spend attributed to a model and token_unit_type, or `other` for cost that doesn't break out by model (e.g. "Assistants API"). Only present when the `cost` table is synced.

cost_attribution_method.name: cost_attribution_method
cost_attribution_method.comment: How `openai_cost` was determined: `direct` (Costs API-reported), `allocated` (inferred via rate card), `unallocated`, or `unmatched` (cost with no completion volume to allocate against, or completion volume with no cost data at all). Only present when the `cost` table is synced.

openai_cost.name: openai_cost
openai_cost.comment:
Cost attributed to this row, in the unit given by `currency`. Used directly from `cost_amount`
when the Costs API already reports a project_id; otherwise inferred by applying an implied
per-token rate card. See `cost_attribution_method`. Only present when the `cost` table is synced.

currency.name: currency
currency.comment: Currency code for `openai_cost`, as reported by the Costs API (in practice always `usd`). Only present when the `cost` table is synced.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: openai__enterprise_user_report
metadata.comment: Daily OpenAI Platform activity by user, project, model, and product — completions, embeddings, audio, image, moderation, web search, and file search. Cost isn't available at this grain; the Costs endpoint doesn't report per-user attribution.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The record's source if the unioning functionality is used. Otherwise this field will be empty.

date_day.name: date_day
date_day.comment: Day the cost and usage apply to.

actor_user_id.name: actor_user_id
actor_user_id.comment: Identifier of the OpenAI Platform user this activity or summary belongs to. Joins to `stg_openai__users.user_id`.

actor_email.name: actor_email
actor_email.comment: Email address of the person behind this activity, lowercased. Used as the durable person key across the enterprise and Codex reports, since it survives key rotations and offboarding in a way an internal ID does not.

project_id.name: project_id
project_id.comment: Unique identifier for the OpenAI Platform project. Null for products that don't report a project_id.

project_name.name: project_name
project_name.comment: Display name of the OpenAI Platform project. Only present when the `project` table is synced.

model.name: model
model.comment: Name of the OpenAI model used for this request (e.g. `gpt-4o`, `text-embedding-3-small`).

model_family.name: model_family
model_family.comment: Structural reporting family parsed from the model name, preserving version lines such as `gpt-4o`, `gpt-5.2`, and `o4`. Fine-tuned `ft:` names use their base model. `openai_model_family_overrides` takes precedence for exact base-model names. Unrecognized names return the original model value.

model_variant.name: model_variant
model_variant.comment: The model-name suffix remaining after its family and any dated snapshot suffix are removed — for example, `gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18` yields `mini`. Null when no suffix remains or the name is unrecognized.

product.name: product
product.comment: OpenAI product this activity came from — `completion`, `embedding`, `audio_transcription`, `audio_speech`, `image`, `moderation`, `web_search`, or `file_search`.

quantity.name: quantity
quantity.comment: Amount consumed, in the unit named by `quantity_unit`. Only additive within a single unit — null for products with no comparable single-request measure (`image`, `web_search`, `file_search`).

quantity_unit.name: quantity_unit
quantity_unit.comment: Unit `quantity` is denominated in — `tokens` (`completion`, `embedding`, `moderation`), `seconds` (`audio_transcription`), `characters` (`audio_speech`), or null.

num_model_requests.name: num_model_requests
num_model_requests.comment: Model requests for model products; tool-call counts (`num_requests`) for `web_search` and `file_search`, which may not map 1:1 to a model request.
